\title{Quantum geometry multipole}
\maketitle

\section{Analytic formulae}

Quantum geometry (QG)
\[
Q_{n}^{ij}=\sum_{m\left(\neq n\right)}A_{nm}^{i}A_{mn}^{j}=\sum_{m\left(\neq n\right)}\frac{\langle u_{n}|v_{i}|u_{m}\rangle\langle u_{m}|v_{j}|u_{n}\rangle}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{2}}
\]
Quantum metric (QM)
\[
g_{n}^{ij}=\text{Re}Q_{n}^{ij}
\]
Berry curvature (BC)
\[
\Omega_{n}^{ij}=2\text{Im}Q_{n}^{ij}
\]

quantum geometry dipole (QGD)
\[
Q_{n}^{lj}=\sum_{m\left(\neq n\right)}\frac{\langle u_{n}|v_{l}|u_{m}\rangle\langle u_{m}|v_{j}|u_{n}\rangle}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{2}}
\]
\begin{align*}
\partial_{i}Q_{n}^{lj} & =\sum_{m\left(\neq n\right)}\left[\frac{\langle\partial_{i}u_{n}|v_{l}|u_{m}\rangle\langle u_{m}|v_{j}|u_{n}\rangle}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{2}}+\frac{\langle u_{n}|v_{l}|u_{m}\rangle\langle u_{m}|v_{j}|\partial_{i}u_{n}\rangle}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{2}}\right.\\
 & +\frac{\langle u_{n}|v_{l}|\partial_{i}u_{m}\rangle\langle u_{m}|v_{j}|u_{n}\rangle}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{2}}+\frac{\langle u_{n}|v_{l}|u_{m}\rangle\langle\partial_{i}u_{m}|v_{j}|u_{n}\rangle}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{2}}\\
 & +\frac{\langle u_{n}|\partial_{i}v_{l}|u_{m}\rangle\langle u_{m}|v_{j}|u_{n}\rangle}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{2}}+\frac{\langle u_{n}|v_{l}|u_{m}\rangle\langle u_{m}|\partial_{i}v_{j}|u_{n}\rangle}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{2}}\\
 & \left.+\langle u_{n}|v_{l}|u_{m}\rangle\langle u_{m}|v_{j}|u_{n}\rangle\partial_{i}\frac{1}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{2}}\right]\\
 & =\frac{\mathbf{V}^{i}}{\Delta\varepsilon}\mathbf{V}^{l}\frac{\mathbf{V}^{j}}{\Delta\varepsilon^{2}}-\frac{\mathbf{V}^{l}}{\Delta\varepsilon^{2}}\mathbf{V}^{j}\frac{\mathbf{V}^{i}}{\Delta\varepsilon}\\
 & -\mathbf{V}^{l}\frac{\mathbf{V}^{i}}{\Delta\varepsilon}\frac{\mathbf{V}^{j}}{\Delta\varepsilon^{2}}+\frac{\mathbf{V}^{l}}{\Delta\varepsilon^{2}}\frac{\mathbf{V}^{i}}{\Delta\varepsilon}\mathbf{V}^{j}\\
 & +\bm{\Gamma}^{il}\frac{\mathbf{V}^{j}}{\Delta\varepsilon^{2}}+\frac{\mathbf{V}^{l}}{\Delta\varepsilon^{2}}\bm{\Gamma}^{ij}\\
 & -2\frac{\mathbf{V}^{l}}{\Delta\varepsilon^{3}}\left[\mathbf{V}^{j},\mathbf{V}_{F}^{i}\right]\\
 & =\left(\bm{\Gamma}^{il}+\left[\frac{\mathbf{V}^{i}}{\Delta\varepsilon},\mathbf{V}^{l}\right]\right)\frac{\mathbf{V}^{j}}{\Delta\varepsilon^{2}}\\
 & +\frac{\mathbf{V}^{l}}{\Delta\varepsilon^{2}}\left(\bm{\Gamma}^{ij}+\left[\frac{\mathbf{V}^{i}}{\Delta\varepsilon},\mathbf{V}^{j}\right]\right)\\
 & -2\frac{\mathbf{V}^{l}}{\Delta\varepsilon^{3}}\left[\mathbf{V}^{j},\mathbf{V}_{F}^{i}\right]
\end{align*}
\begin{align*}
\partial_{k}Q_{n}^{ij} & =\sum_{m\left(\neq n\right)}\left[\sum_{p\left(\neq n\right)}\frac{\langle u_{n}|v_{k}|u_{p}\rangle\langle u_{p}|v_{i}|u_{m}\rangle\langle u_{m}|v_{j}|u_{n}\rangle}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{2}\varepsilon_{np}}+\sum_{p\left(\neq n\right)}\frac{\langle u_{n}|v_{i}|u_{m}\rangle\langle u_{m}|v_{j}|u_{p}\rangle\langle u_{p}|v_{k}|u_{n}\rangle}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{2}\varepsilon_{np}}\right.\\
 & +\sum_{p\left(\neq m\right)}\frac{\langle u_{n}|v_{i}|u_{p}\rangle\langle u_{p}|v_{k}|u_{m}\rangle\langle u_{m}|v_{j}|u_{n}\rangle}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{2}\varepsilon_{mp}}+\sum_{p\left(\neq m\right)}\frac{\langle u_{n}|v_{i}|u_{m}\rangle\langle u_{m}|v_{k}|u_{p}\rangle\langle u_{p}|v_{j}|u_{n}\rangle}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{2}\varepsilon_{mp}}\\
 & +\frac{\Gamma_{nm}^{ki}\langle u_{m}|v_{j}|u_{n}\rangle}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{2}}+\frac{\langle u_{n}|v_{i}|u_{m}\rangle\Gamma_{mn}^{kj}}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{2}}\\
 & -\left.2\langle u_{n}|v_{i}|u_{m}\rangle\langle u_{m}|v_{j}|u_{n}\rangle\frac{v_{n}^{k}-v_{m}^{k}}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{3}}\right]
\end{align*}
\[
\partial_{k}Q_{n}^{ij}=\partial_{k}Q_{n}^{ij,\text{I}}+\partial_{k}Q_{n}^{ij,\text{II}}
\]
one-summation term (QGD-I)
\[
\partial_{k}Q_{n}^{ij,\text{I}}=\sum_{m\left(\neq n\right)}\left[\frac{\Gamma_{nm}^{ki}\langle u_{m}|v_{j}|u_{n}\rangle}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{2}}+\frac{\langle u_{n}|v_{i}|u_{m}\rangle\Gamma_{mn}^{kj}}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{2}}-2\langle u_{n}|v_{i}|u_{m}\rangle\langle u_{m}|v_{j}|u_{n}\rangle\frac{v_{n}^{k}-v_{m}^{k}}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{3}}\right]
\]
where $\Gamma_{nm}^{ki}$ is interband the inverse mass 
\[
\Gamma_{nm}^{ki}=\langle u_{n}|\partial_{k}\partial_{i}H|u_{m}\rangle
\]
and $v_{n}^{k}$ is the Fermi velocity of band $n$
\[
v_{n}^{k}=\partial_{k}\varepsilon_{n}=\langle u_{n}|v_{k}|u_{n}\rangle
\]
two-summation term (QGD-II)
\begin{align*}
\partial_{k}Q_{n}^{ij,\text{II}} & =\sum_{m\left(\neq n\right)}\left[\sum_{p\left(\neq n\right)}\frac{\langle u_{n}|v_{k}|u_{p}\rangle\langle u_{p}|v_{i}|u_{m}\rangle\langle u_{m}|v_{j}|u_{n}\rangle}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{2}\varepsilon_{np}}+\sum_{p\left(\neq n\right)}\frac{\langle u_{n}|v_{i}|u_{m}\rangle\langle u_{m}|v_{j}|u_{p}\rangle\langle u_{p}|v_{k}|u_{n}\rangle}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{2}\varepsilon_{np}}\right.\\
 & +\left.\sum_{p\left(\neq m\right)}\frac{\langle u_{n}|v_{i}|u_{p}\rangle\langle u_{p}|v_{k}|u_{m}\rangle\langle u_{m}|v_{j}|u_{n}\rangle}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{2}\varepsilon_{mp}}+\sum_{p\left(\neq m\right)}\frac{\langle u_{n}|v_{i}|u_{m}\rangle\langle u_{m}|v_{k}|u_{p}\rangle\langle u_{p}|v_{j}|u_{n}\rangle}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{2}\varepsilon_{mp}}\right]
\end{align*}

Quantum geometry quadrupole

\section{Matrix representation}

\subsection{Ingredients }

Velocity matrix in energy band space (Hamiltonian gauge)
\[
\left[\mathbf{V}^{i}\right]_{nm}=\langle u_{n}|v_{i}|u_{m}\rangle
\]
band-normalized velocity matrix (interband Berry connection for $q=1$)
\[
\left[\frac{\mathbf{V}^{i}}{\Delta\varepsilon^{q}}\right]_{nm}=\frac{\langle u_{n}|v_{i}|u_{m}\rangle}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{q}}\left(1-\delta_{nm}\right)
\]
Inverse mass matrix
\[
\bm{\Gamma}_{nm}^{ij}=\langle u_{n}|\partial_{j}v_{i}|u_{m}\rangle
\]
Fermi velocity matrix
\[
\left[\mathbf{V}_{F}^{i}\right]_{nm}=\langle u_{n}|v_{i}|u_{n}\rangle\delta_{nm}
\]


\subsection{QG and QG multipole}

QG

\[
Q_{n}^{ij}=\left[\mathbf{Q}^{ij}\right]_{nn}
\]
\[
\mathbf{Q}^{ij}=-\frac{\mathbf{V}^{i}}{\Delta\varepsilon}\frac{\mathbf{V}^{j}}{\Delta\varepsilon}
\]

QGD
\[
\partial_{k}Q_{n}^{ij,\text{I}}=\left[\partial_{k}\mathbf{Q}^{ij,\text{I}}\right]_{nn}
\]
\[
\partial_{k}\mathbf{Q}^{ij,\text{I}}=\bm{\Gamma}^{ki}\frac{\mathbf{V}^{j}}{\Delta\varepsilon^{2}}+\frac{\mathbf{V}^{i}}{\Delta\varepsilon^{2}}\bm{\Gamma}^{kj}-2\left[\mathbf{V}_{F}^{k},\frac{\mathbf{V}^{i}}{\Delta\varepsilon}\right]\frac{\mathbf{V}^{j}}{\Delta\varepsilon^{2}}
\]
\[
\partial_{k}Q_{n}^{ij,\text{II}}=\left[\partial_{k}\mathbf{Q}^{ij,\text{II}}\right]_{nn}
\]
\begin{align*}
\partial_{k}Q_{n}^{ij,\text{II}} & =\sum_{m\left(\neq n\right)}\left[\sum_{p\left(\neq n\right)}\frac{\langle u_{n}|v_{k}|u_{p}\rangle\langle u_{p}|v_{i}|u_{m}\rangle\langle u_{m}|v_{j}|u_{n}\rangle}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{2}\varepsilon_{np}}+\sum_{p\left(\neq n\right)}\frac{\langle u_{n}|v_{i}|u_{m}\rangle\langle u_{m}|v_{j}|u_{p}\rangle\langle u_{p}|v_{k}|u_{n}\rangle}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{2}\varepsilon_{np}}\right.\\
 & +\left.\sum_{p\left(\neq m\right)}\frac{\langle u_{n}|v_{i}|u_{p}\rangle\langle u_{p}|v_{k}|u_{m}\rangle\langle u_{m}|v_{j}|u_{n}\rangle}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{2}\varepsilon_{mp}}+\sum_{p\left(\neq m\right)}\frac{\langle u_{n}|v_{i}|u_{m}\rangle\langle u_{m}|v_{k}|u_{p}\rangle\langle u_{p}|v_{j}|u_{n}\rangle}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{2}\varepsilon_{mp}}\right]
\end{align*}
\[
\partial_{k}\mathbf{Q}^{ij,\text{II}}=\left[\frac{\mathbf{V}^{k}}{\Delta\varepsilon},\mathbf{V}^{i}\right]\frac{\mathbf{V}^{j}}{\Delta\varepsilon^{2}}+\frac{\mathbf{V}^{i}}{\Delta\varepsilon^{2}}\left[\frac{\mathbf{V}^{k}}{\Delta\varepsilon},\mathbf{V}^{j}\right]
\]

QGQ
\begin{align*}
\partial_{\ell}\partial_{k}\mathbf{Q}^{ij,\text{I}} & =2\bm{\Gamma}^{ki}\left[\frac{\mathbf{V}^{j}}{\Delta\varepsilon^{3}},\mathbf{V}_{F}^{\ell}\right]-2\frac{\mathbf{V}^{i}}{\Delta\varepsilon^{3}}\left[\bm{\Gamma}^{kj},\mathbf{V}_{F}^{\ell}\right]-\frac{\bm{\Gamma}^{ki}}{\Delta\varepsilon}\frac{\bm{\Gamma}^{\ell j}}{\Delta\varepsilon}-\frac{\bm{\Gamma}^{\ell i}}{\Delta\varepsilon}\frac{\bm{\Gamma}^{kj}}{\Delta\varepsilon}\\
 & -6\frac{\mathbf{V}^{i}}{\Delta\varepsilon^{2}}\left(\mathbf{V}_{F}^{k}\mathbf{V}_{F}^{\ell}\frac{\mathbf{V}^{j}}{\Delta\varepsilon^{2}}+\frac{\mathbf{V}^{j}}{\Delta\varepsilon^{2}}\mathbf{V}_{F}^{k}\mathbf{V}_{F}^{\ell}-\mathbf{V}_{F}^{\ell}\frac{\mathbf{V}^{j}}{\Delta\varepsilon^{2}}\mathbf{V}_{F}^{k}-\mathbf{V}_{F}^{k}\frac{\mathbf{V}^{j}}{\Delta\varepsilon^{2}}\mathbf{V}_{F}^{\ell}\right)
\end{align*}
\begin{align*}
\partial_{\ell}\partial_{k}\mathbf{Q}^{ij,\text{I}} & =2\left[\frac{\mathbf{V}^{k}}{\Delta\varepsilon},\mathbf{V}^{i}\right]\left[\frac{\mathbf{V}^{j}}{\Delta\varepsilon^{3}},\mathbf{V}_{F}^{\ell}\right]+2\left[\mathbf{V}_{F}^{\ell},\frac{\mathbf{V}^{i}}{\Delta\varepsilon^{3}}\right]\left[\mathbf{V}^{j},\frac{\mathbf{V}^{k}}{\Delta\varepsilon}\right]\\
 & +2\left[\frac{\mathbf{V}^{\ell}}{\Delta\varepsilon},\mathbf{V}^{i}\right]\left[\frac{\mathbf{V}^{j}}{\Delta\varepsilon^{3}},\mathbf{V}_{F}^{k}\right]+2\left[\mathbf{V}_{F}^{k},\frac{\mathbf{V}^{i}}{\Delta\varepsilon^{3}}\right]\left[\mathbf{V}^{j},\frac{\mathbf{V}^{\ell}}{\Delta\varepsilon}\right]\\
 & +\left[\frac{\mathbf{V}^{k}}{\Delta\varepsilon},\bm{\Gamma}^{\ell i}\right]\frac{\mathbf{V}^{j}}{\Delta\varepsilon^{2}}+\frac{\bm{\Gamma}^{\ell i}}{\Delta\varepsilon^{2}}\left[\frac{\mathbf{V}^{k}}{\Delta\varepsilon},\mathbf{V}^{j}\right]\\
 & +\left[\frac{\mathbf{V}^{\ell}}{\Delta\varepsilon},\bm{\Gamma}^{ki}\right]\frac{\mathbf{V}^{j}}{\Delta\varepsilon^{2}}+\frac{\bm{\Gamma}^{ki}}{\Delta\varepsilon^{2}}\left[\frac{\mathbf{V}^{\ell}}{\Delta\varepsilon},\mathbf{V}^{j}\right]\\
 & +\frac{\mathbf{V}^{i}}{\Delta\varepsilon^{2}}\left[\frac{\mathbf{V}^{k}}{\Delta\varepsilon},\bm{\Gamma}^{\ell j}\right]+\left[\frac{\mathbf{V}^{k}}{\Delta\varepsilon},\mathbf{V}^{i}\right]\frac{\bm{\Gamma}^{\ell j}}{\Delta\varepsilon^{2}}\\
 & +\frac{\mathbf{V}^{i}}{\Delta\varepsilon^{2}}\left[\frac{\mathbf{V}^{\ell}}{\Delta\varepsilon},\bm{\Gamma}^{kj}\right]+\left[\frac{\mathbf{V}^{\ell}}{\Delta\varepsilon},\mathbf{V}^{i}\right]\frac{\bm{\Gamma}^{kj}}{\Delta\varepsilon^{2}}
\end{align*}

\[
H_{ij}\left(\bm{k}\right)=\sum_{\delta\bm{R}}H_{ij}\left(\delta\bm{R}\right)e^{i\bm{k}\cdot\delta\bm{R}}
\]
